name: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo - Season 2001
source:
Tenshitachi no Gogo takes place in a Japanese high school. The goal is to seduce the star girl of the tennis club, Shiraishi Yumiko. To do this, the player needs to go around talking with her friends and possibly getting intimate with them as well.

[Edited From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tenshitachi_no_gogo]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《天使们的午后》发生在一所日本高中里。目标是引诱网球社的明星选手白石由美子。为此，玩家需要四处与她的朋友们交谈，甚至可能与她们发展亲密关系。

[改编自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tenshitachi_no_gogo]Wikipedia[/url]]
